## Highlights

This release features 594 commits from 277 contributors (91 new)!

* **Model Runner V2 is now the default for all models** (#53183), completing the rollout that began with pooling models (#48290). MRV2 also gained CUDA graph memory profiling for KV cache auto-sizing (#53306), batch-sharded sampling that cuts per-step logits memory by 1/TP (#50465), prompt embeds (#42963), `extract_hidden_states` speculation (#49811), padded FULL cudagraph dispatch for uniform decode under spec decode (#53407), and DP-sync skipping before EAGLE/MTP draft prefill (#53694). MRV1 remains in use for a few ROCm models and features MRV2 does not yet support.

candidates.summary:
## Overview

llama.cpp v0.7.0 adds the LiliCorr speculative decoding technique and MTP for GLM5-Next, a new GPU cache for MoE experts kept in host memory (`--moe-cache-mib`, up to ~2.2x decode speedup when experts are offloaded), and a large batch of new models: K2 Horizon (dense and MoVA), Prism Bonsai 2 27B, EmbeddingGemma-2 (text+vision+audio), the LiquidAI d1/d1-omni and vLLM decision 2/d3 decision models, pplx-decider, MiniCPM-V 4.7, Nemotron Super 3.5 VL / Nemotron Bolt and maion-coder. The server gets a refactored chat session API (`common_chat_session`, part-based formatted output), much better slot and prompt-cache restore behavior, decision-model support for the new architectures and a new default port (9931), the web UI gains a full models manager, and ggml is updated to v0.27
